version: HERO v2.1, support-defined cross-temperature discovery. Separate estimand, pre-outcome, supervised 14:58 UTC. NO native forward optimization or native objective values are used or authorized to choose this panel. Same code families and temperature-balanced training population as v2; no new arms or independent assessments.
population: Keep the entire v2 TRAIN pool including deep beta, all source embargoes, training seed/batch/law/fraction alignment and capacity. The original nine-beta selection statistic is permanently not estimable on this assignment. v2.1 ranks models exclusively on a prospectively defined subset of temperatures, not an imputation or repair of the original estimand. A temperature excluded here can contribute to optimization but has no v2.1 discovery or inference claim. Index 6 never enters.
eligibility: Apply identical rule to every index with an eligible FIT pool. On original even development ONLY, require (i) at least 4*8=32 distinct parents for uniform groups, (ii) at least 90% of all their 64-anchor opportunities survive the original >=8 distinct same-S-parent condition, (iii) at least four mutually parent-disjoint legal matched groups. Test (iii) deterministically by processing S in decreasing number of distinct parents, then increasing S on ties: in each S, consider its as-yet-unassigned parents in native roster order, allocate as many complete 8-parent groups as possible and retire those parents; report resulting lower bound. Feasibility, not a variance estimate. Selection does not use temperatures, f, labels, shell values, logits, retrieval performance, energy, or outcomes. Freeze indices publicly BEFORE any native optimizer step; if fewer than two indices qualify or beta-zero fails, no v2.1 nomination. Never loosen criteria. Report each rejected index with which test failed; count the full withheld index separately.
matched_counts_only: Compute only registered S(V) inventory/coordination counts from the even-dev slice, verifying bytes against its existing even-parity digest; do not open E, I or odd/dev/exam feature data. Per-bin count distinct parents, retained anchor and parent coverage, uniform group bound, lower bound disjoint matched groups; no raw patch output. Eval roster sizes from metadata only; held centers stay sealed.
model_selection: Discovery-only score is arithmetic mean over all AND ONLY the eligible locked betas of half uniform + half matched equal-candidate proper hard retrieval gain. No pooled-across-beta matching. Detach unavailable nine-beta macro from code; per-temperature support and score remain visible. Three paired seeds (6101-3), all four arms and fractions 1/16,1/4,1 with the existing minimum; same 1024,2048,4096,8192 update rungs. At full fraction 8192, nominate best arch per law by mean of paired-seed supported-panel scores, tie affine. Add independent seeds 6104 and 6105 to both finalists if affordable. Double updates at fixed full data under the original stopping design (max 65536). Select one final arm, hard initialized category and discovery-only alignment, matched fixed controls; only finalists may merit full additional depth. Require actual complete positive coverage by beta for declared full-sample fits. No assessment data for schedule or thresholds. Old v2 nomination file may not be created by this work. Published gross affordability and cutoffs still govern before paid main batch.
downstream: Only v2.1 discovery weights may drive v2.1 interpretation. Data for alignment/dictionary selection, central ordinary residual and same-f development forecast use only supported-panel FIT / registered odd-dev parents of that panel with equal beta, then parent then anchor. Use same 8 anchor ordinals, one f, one sign, fixed-frame gate, matched random controls and optional nonpromoting FIT-only cubic alignment, no changes to physical target or baselines. Preserve all thresholds, whole-parent uncertainty and family correction; beta zero remains a finite-composition negative control. Report excluded beta training coverage but no deep-beta physical conclusion. No exam access, blind issuance, cavity simulation, transfer, or fresh MCMC in v2.1. No independent/confirmatory claim even on a strong result. No validation-only result claimed as unseen-temperature transfer.
assessment_power: Metadata-only planning; hold all assessments closed. Report per-beta independent evaluation n, and odd-dev n. At true effect .02 above margin .01, report the maximum parent-effect SD for 80% power for a lower two-sided t95 > margin, by numerical upper-tail noncentral t at df=n-1; repeat with Bonferroni over supported nonzero temperatures; report illustrative powers for SD=.05,.10,.20,.50. For support-defined macro give equal-SD finite-panel Welch-Satterthwaite planning counterpart. No outcome-free assertion of adequate physical power. If and only if a physical same-f dev forecast exists, estimate projected power using per-beta odd-dev whole-parent variances and the unchanged evaluation sizes; no exam opening. Adequate groups for model selection is not adequate assessment power.
controls: All numerical controls and hard encoding sensitivity gates unchanged; $25 remaining aggregate incremental original cap; all costs/meters and one H100 at a time unchanged. No new pilot arm slate or best-temperature/seed selection.
